products.title: Hiboy KS4 Pro Premium Electric Scooter

description.html: An electric scooter is faster and more efficient than a motor or kick scooter. The Hiboy KS4 Pro Premium electric scooter is the best fit for riders looking for a powerful yet lightweight electric scooter. The Hiboy KS4 Pro electric scooter has a 500W (Peak 750W) motor and a high-capacity battery. With a high speed of 19 mph, it smoothly achieves 25 miles of travel range per charge under specific conditions. It suits city commuting and traveling, helping you conquer up to a 15% grade slope. The powerful 500 W motor makes it ideal for city commuting and extended travel. It has 10-inch honeycomb tires for a stable ride and three brilliant light systems: headlight, taillight, and sidelight, for riding safely at night. The Hiboy KS4 Pro Premium electric scooter also has a 36 V 11.6 Ah battery, dual rear suspensions, customized cruise and speed control, and dual braking.

Our collection has an array options and colors, so everyone can buy their ideal e-scooter. Decide which of our motorized scooters is perfect for your commute as you ride around town in style.
